w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (tick, Big Loud, The Callback, Loud-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Buffering is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Agnese lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 6× Cattail (720 kcal). You also gather deadfall: 1× branches. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Ivy freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Ivy: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: Rubble chokes the path.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Ava freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
You turn to leave — behind you, The Editor stirs.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 4× Common Plantain, 8× Blackberry (660 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Ivy freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Ava: "Stay close, yeah?"

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE SPOILER! You're on your own.
firstContext: No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You don't know what that was. A voiceover that knows too much. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE SPOILER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE SPOILER! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Commercial Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Ines opens the pantry wide: 6× Foraged food, 1× Expedition haul. Agnese, Saiful, Ivy eat until the fire burns low. noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
